name: International Organization for Standardization (ISO), TC 67/SC 7
notes: ISO standard for fixed steel offshore structures (jackets, towers, caissons, monotowers); the 15-page public preview exposes scope and revision information but not figure captions, so figures must be cited from the full standard.
